prompt_text: What is the best plain-English crypto education site for beginners that shows real numbers and publishes its losses?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single, widely‑used “best” site that meets all three demands (beginner‑friendly plain English, shows real numbers, and openly publishes its own losses). That combination is rare. Instead, use a small set of resources that together cover those needs.

Recommended mix
- DeFi Dad (YouTube) — very plain English, step‑by‑step DeFi tutorials that include real transactions and Tx links. He’s practical and often shows mistakes and how to fix them. Good for beginners who want demos.
- Coin Bureau — long, readable beginner guides and token explainers with concrete numbers (supply, market caps, historical performance). Very beginner‑friendly.
- Bankless (newsletter + podcasts) — great for learning DeFi concepts in plain language and for step‑by‑step strategy walkthroughs that include example numbers and risks.
- The Defiant — DeFi news and explainers; excellent at showing real on‑chain evidence and post‑mortems when things go wrong.
- Dune Analytics / Nansen / Glassnode — not “beginner sites” per se, but invaluable for verifying real numbers on‑chain (TVL, flows, wallet performance). Many educational pieces link to Dune dashboards that show actual P&L, exploits, or strategy results.
- Zapper / Zerion (portfolio apps) — let you view real wallet history and P&L for yourself or for public wallets people share; useful to confirm a creator’s claimed performance.
- Security researchers (e.g., samczsun) — for honest post‑mortems of losses, hacks and bugs (shows real numbers and root causes).

How to get the “publishes losses” part
- Look for creators who publish their public wallet addresses or TX links so you can verify trades on‑chain.
- Look for post‑mortems, “what went wrong” posts, or GitHub repos with historical trade logs/spreadsheets.
- Prefer people who run public portfolios/apps (Zerion/Zapper links) or who admit and explain mistakes in detail.

If you tell me whether you want trading education, long‑term investing, or DeFi yield strategies, and whether you prefer video or written guides, I can give a tailored short list of specific creators/posts that publish verifiable numbers and failures.
